scope: Retrospectively redesigned GDSC2-to-CTRPv2 transfer to previously unseen cancer cell-model biological groups; shared CCLE expression, different response screens, no clinical or cross-expression-platform claim

final_training.input_response: Original frozen GDSC2 continuous AUC at each drug's locked exact dose window; higher means greater viability/lower sensitivity
final_training.inner_splitter: modeling.nested_cv.make_grouped_splits: tissue-stratified StratifiedGroupKFold over 626 global biological groups, restricted to each drug; one shared split assignment across arms
final_training.inner_fit_boundary: Every candidate/fold re-fits detection, candidate genes, representation, scaling, FWL tissue state, alpha_max and EN on that inner training subset only
final_training.molecular_grid: Exactly 10 candidates: alpha_max ratios [1,0.3,0.1,0.03,0.01] x l1 ratios [0.5,1.0], as source_model_config; ratio 1 retains analytic zero solution
final_training.selection_objective: Pooled inner OOF RMSE in original GDSC2 AUC units; first exact grid tie, no external response or distribution use
final_training.refit: All qualifying development rows for each drug, once with the inner-selected candidate; tissue_null fits once without HPO

serialization.format: joblib with trusted local loads only; retain one model and one audit record per drug x arm
serialization.required_state: Selected stable Ensembl gene IDs in ascending output order, raw full-input stable gene column order/hash, representation and oriented pair feature order/hash, training scaler/target/FWL/tissue states, hyperparameters, zero-solution flag, training membership hashes, source/environment hashes
serialization.reload_test: Fresh process reload on synthetic/development-only sentinel rows; same sample order and predictions within absolute tolerance 1e-12, relative tolerance 0, including known/unknown tissue, ties and a zero-molecular case
serialization.immutable_manifest: SHA-256 for every artifact, source file, configuration, prepared input and lock before external response access

external_endpoint.source: CTRPv2 post-QC concentration-response curve AUC, using frozen eligible experiments and compound/model identity
external_endpoint.repeat_aggregation: Median eligible experiment AUC per frozen compound and canonical model, once; experiments do not increase independent N
external_endpoint.direction: Keep raw source AUC direction. Greater viability-curve area implies greater survival/lower drug sensitivity. Never choose a sign from external associations.
external_endpoint.cross_screen_scale: GDSC2 and CTRPv2 use different dose windows/AUC conventions; no absolute cross-screen calibration, label normalization, quantile mapping or response-dependent recoding

external_gateway.primary_population: Locked cancer-v2 external primary cohort only; 175 unique biological groups and 1185 drug-model eligibility rows before prediction QC
external_gateway.identity: Frozen exact compound and canonical cell-model mappings; zero overlap with any development model/group and known GDSC candidate group; mismatch is a hard gate failure
external_gateway.expression_input: The same versioned full raw float64 TPM stable-gene matrix, with exactly all locked gene columns in exact stable-ID order; missing, extra or reordered columns are a hard schema failure
external_gateway.molecular_abstention: With a valid complete column schema, any sample-level missing, nonnumeric, nonfinite or negative full raw TPM value makes all seven molecular arms abstain; no imputation, tie substitution, sample dropping without a reason, or score-dependent rescue
external_gateway.tissue_null_on_molecular_abstention: Predict if exact identity and nonmissing valid tissue are available; raw TPM is not used in its prediction
external_gateway.unknown_tissue: A valid but unseen tissue label maps to trained global response mean in tissue_null; molecular models keep their molecular residual term with zero unseen-tissue adjustment. Record unknown-tissue flag.
external_gateway.missing_or_invalid_tissue: No valid prediction for any arm; record reason and retain row in the frozen eligibility denominator
external_gateway.zero_molecular_coefficients: Valid prediction, not abstention or failed fit; flag zero-molecular state
external_gateway.prediction_output: One row per frozen drug x canonical model x arm with identity, biological group, eligibility denominator membership, gateway status/reason, prediction or NA, unknown-tissue/zero-solution flags and artifact hash
external_gateway.hard_failures: Source, input or model hash mismatch; missing, extra or reordered expected gene columns; duplicate/conflicting canonical identity; development/external group overlap; wrong drug compound mapping; unexpected endpoint field or dose-window convention; nonfinite fitted-model prediction
external_gateway.coverage_reporting: For each drug, retain frozen eligible N, response-valid N, each arm predicted N, each paired common-ID N, unique biological-group N and all noncoverage reason counts; never silently reduce the fixed eight-drug panel

statistics.primary_metric: Spearman rank correlation between frozen fixed-model predictions and original-direction CTRPv2 AUC within each drug
statistics.undefined_spearman: NA when fewer than three distinct groups, constant response, constant prediction, missing/nonfinite input or any failed arm; retain exact reason and N
statistics.paired_common_id_rule: For each drug and contrast, both arms scored on exactly the same canonical models and same single aggregated CTRPv2 label; compute each Spearman on that paired intersection, then candidate minus reference

primary_comparison.direction: candidate Spearman minus reference Spearman; positive favors candidate
primary_comparison.family_members: Eight fixed drug contrasts and their equal-eight-drug macro

same_candidate_representation_family.family_members: Two contrasts x (eight fixed drug contrasts plus each equal-eight-drug macro); interpretation only, separate from primary family

statistics.macro: Equal mean over all eight preselected drug effects, never observation-weighted; if any drug point contrast undefined, strict macro is NA with all eight definition flags. A draw with any undefined drug effect has undefined macro.
statistics.low_coverage_flag: Any paired common-ID count below 80 biological groups is flagged as below original design coverage; show descriptive point if defined but no strong transfer claim

bootstrap.generator: NumPy PCG64 with a logged SeedSequence and exact version; save group order and multiplicity-matrix SHA-256
bootstrap.unit: All 175 frozen external biological groups sampled with replacement on every draw; a single shared multiplicity vector is used across all drugs, models and contrasts
bootstrap.calculation: Within each drug and paired common-ID set, apply group multiplicities to both arms and the same label, recompute exact tied midranks and Spearman, then contrasts and strict eight-drug macro
bootstrap.interval: Percentile with linear quantile interpolation; unadjusted nominal 95% descriptive intervals and Bonferroni nominal family-0.05 conditional intervals
bootstrap.invalid_draw_rule: Retain reason counts. If an estimand has fewer than 19800 valid draws, its interval is NA; no re-draws, shrinking family, or silently using a subset of drugs.
bootstrap.inference_scope: Conditional on the already-trained fixed models and this retrospective external cohort; no training/refit, model-selection, historical-selection or drug-population uncertainty

statistics.auxiliary: Report every arm's rho and coverage, tissue-null comparison on matched molecular coverage, zero-solution/unknown-tissue strata and drug heterogeneity descriptively; no external outcome-driven model choice
statistics.absolute_error: No RMSE, MAE or R2 cross-screen efficacy claim because original GDSC2 and CTRPv2 AUC scales/dose windows are not calibrated; no test-set recalibration
statistics.noninferiority: No margin, test or equivalence claim

pre_fit_gates: Verify exact intended CTRPv2 post-QC AUC source column, direction, repeated-experiment median policy and dose-window metadata using official source documentation plus already-frozen curation metadata/code only; do not open external response or response index
Verify locked eight compound IDs and GDSC2/CTRPv2 concentration metadata, source/input hashes, and no development/external identity overlap

Implement and pass response-free synthetic gateway and statistical tests for complete/missing/negative/nonfinite TPM, unknown/missing tissue, exact ties, zero-molecular solution, duplicate identity, constant predictions, paired coverage and shared-group bootstrap
Complete an independent pre-fit code/protocol review with every blocking issue fixed, and record the synthetic test commands, results and source hashes in the pre-fit acceptance report

Freeze this v1.1 protocol/config and all training and scoring/statistical code in config/external_validation_v1_1.lock.json before any final full-development fit; preserve the earlier v1 lock and its zero-fit guard failure
pre_external_gates: Fit and retain all 64 final models with 1744 expected fit events; verify training-only inner folds, every candidate/feature audit and all artifact hashes without external response access
Independently reload all 64 artifacts in a fresh process and pass the frozen sentinel prediction agreement tests

Create immutable config/external_execution_v1_1.lock.json with status=frozen_pre_external_response, binding the v1.1 pre-fit lock, every model artifact and exact external scoring code; independently validate the no-response preflight before reading CTRP response or response index
post_fit_gate_pending: The v1 lock was generated but its first real controller start failed before all fits because the old guard blocked hashing response-free CTRP metadata. This v1.1 amendment permits only three hashed source-metadata files while still blocking the CTRP curve response and response index. Real 64-model/1,744-fit completion, independent reload, response-free preflight and a distinct v1.1 second execution lock remain mandatory before CTRP response access.
